title: How is Hitler connected to the first man on the Moon?
description: Five real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Neil Armstrong.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Neil Armstrong?

links.line: In March 1941, Hitler hosted Japan's foreign minister, Yosuke Matsuoka, in Berlin.

image.file: File:Matsuoka signs the Soviet–Japanese Neutrality Pact-1.jpg

links.line: In April 1941, Matsuoka was in Moscow, signing a neutrality pact as Joseph Stalin looked on.
In 1949, Mao Zedong came to Moscow for Stalin's seventieth birthday.

image.file: File:President Richard Nixon and Mao Zedong.jpg

links.line: In 1972, Richard Nixon became the first American president to visit Mao in China.

image.file: File:President Nixon welcomes the Apollo 11 astronauts aboard the U.S.S. Hornet.jpg

links.line: And back in 1969, Nixon greeted Neil Armstrong through a quarantine window, days after he walked on the Moon.
